_doc: V2 regression fixture #1. Real production session from 2026-06-08. Senior Product Designer @ Flipkart, candidate at 32 LPA, target 44 LPA. v1 looped for 14 turns of discovery + a phantom 40 LPA anchor that was abandoned + a terminal defer with no callback. The invariant v2 must enforce: by the time the candidate has explicitly asked for an offer twice and we are past T6, the legal tool set excludes ask_discovery and includes propose_anchor.

log.text: Thanks for making the time. Let's get straight into it — what's your current CTC — total annual?
my current ctc is 32 LPA
basically, got it on the total — what's the base split?
28 LPA or base
Thanks for that, and on the variable side — how does the performance-linked bonus work in your current side?
28 LPA hike
So tell me — where are you in the process right now, and what's driving this move?
Let me step back. What part of this conversation would be most useful to dig into next — comp, role scope, timeline, or something else?
Got it. On the equity side — does your current package include any ESOPs or RSUs?
this is salary negotiation so you should give your initial offer
Thanks for that - how does your current comp ₹32 LPA fit in the local market?
no there is no equity
I want to make sure I'm being useful here. What's the question you actually came to this conversation with?
Let's keep this focused. Walk me through the current shape of your decision — what's the deciding factor for you right now?
Thanks for that - how does the ₹40 LPA fitment sound for this grade?
you have not yet given initial offer
Yeah, got it. what justifies it — design system ownership, user-research depth, conversion / retention impact?
my expectation is 44 LPA
Let me see what else we can structure on the fitment.
as per the current market standards

On the title side — let me see what we can do about positioning you a level up at the next cycle. Won't commit anything formally now, but these things tend to work themselves out for strong performers.
sure please let me know
Let me confirm the exact figure on our side and come back to you before the offer letter.
can you give me 44 LPA?

_v1_failures: Looped through discovery for 7 turns before any anchor.
Ignored candidate's first explicit offer-ask at T12 (turn-12 candidate message: 'you should give your initial offer').
Anchored 40 LPA at T10 with no rationale, then never referenced it again.
Ignored second explicit offer-ask at T20 ('you have not yet given initial offer').
Closing turn shipped a vague defer with no callback time ('Let me confirm the exact figure and come back to you').
Title fluff at T25 ("positioning you a level up at the next cycle. Won't commit anything formally").
